Important logic: No user → auth screens. Doctor → read-only profile. Other staff roles → web notice. Patient → one tab or overlay; moving screens unmounts the old screen.
Block repeated taps → request server logout with timeout → clear identity/navigation only after success=true. Failure keeps session state and shows an alert.
Load profile, allergies, appointments and prescriptions independently → update successful sections → retain previous failed sections → show partial/all-failed warning.
Choose earliest valid future scheduled/confirmed visit. Active meds counts active/partially-filled prescriptions, excluding valid past expiry; it counts prescriptions, not medicine items.
Load profile and seven lists together; any failure leaves old data. Copy editable name/blood/contact fields → require name → block repeat saves → show only confirmed profile.
Request permission for the chosen source → ignore cancelled selection → reject known size above 2 MB → upload URI/type. Missing size is left to backend checks.
Require a name → send selected allergy severity or condition priority → reload the list. Priority is patient-selected; allergy display orders severe, moderate, mild.

Important feature: Devices, past events and family history
Important logic: Require name/title/condition → save optional details, relationship/event type and chosen emergency flag → reload the affected list.
Native confirmation → request removal → reload that list. A save/delete can succeed before a reload fails, so an error does not prove the write was undone.
Camera/gallery → permission and selection → draft extracted rows → patient reviews. Ignore blank rows; require vaccine name and date on each active row → bulk save.
Edit Mode → block overlapping writes → send complete category list → show confirmed result. Failure keeps old locks; profile Cancel does not undo saved privacy changes.
Load profile → encode qr_code_id only; missing reference shows unavailable. Failed refresh keeps previous card; backend access rules remain required.
Wait 450 ms after typing → send filters → show results/error. Earlier requests are not cancelled. Mobile sends hospitalName but backend reads hospital, so hospital filtering is ignored.

Select date/time → request OPD booking; backend rechecks slots under its lock. For replacement, cancel original afterward. Cancellation failure is logged but success still appears; both visits may remain active.
Scheduled/confirmed/in-progress form Upcoming by status; others form History. Only scheduled cards offer actions. Confirm cancel → server request → update local item after success.

Require profile_id → clear old records/detail → assign load version → ignore older or unmounted responses → newest first/type filters. Consultation detail needs chief complaint; otherwise description is shown.

Important feature: Device report opening and unread status
Important logic: Missing URL → alert. Image → in-app preview. Other document → check device support and await open. Then mark read; update local flag after successful write only.

Past valid device-time expiry overrides saved status. Active/partially-filled plus reference enables QR. Dispensing bar is dispensed ÷ prescribed, limited to 0–100%; server still authorizes dispensing.
Ignore blank/loading sends → copy previous messages → send new text, English/Sinhala and history → append reply/error. Safety notice remains; leaving the screen loses its local conversation.
Keep last exact-title duplicate in memory → trim/filter empty allergy keywords → rank matches → keep image articles. Use loaded image ratio and screen limits for image height.
Rotate every 15 seconds while unpaused → arrows/dots/swipe select slides and schedule resume after 2.5 seconds. Clean up timers on unmount.
Open modal → count down ten seconds; Cancel stops it and Open Dialer Now skips waiting. Trigger opens native dialer; the patient must place the call there.

After dialer attempt, request foreground GPS. Denial sends null coordinates; location/API failure retries without GPS. A second failure warns that hospital delivery is unconfirmed; no separate in-flight guard exists.
Load supplied/session doctor profile → display returned verified/pending state and professional details. Clinical tools remain on web; the notice does not launch a browser.
Profile/record/privacy wrappers validate success and payload shape; other wrappers keep direct payload handling. Legacy role values cannot grant access. The summary wrapper omits consultation ID.
